# Voltsy: Battery Care Buddy

> Voltsy is a free iPhone app that turns battery care into a game with Volt, a cute battery mascot that reacts live to your charge level. It nudges you to keep a healthy 20% to 80% range, sends charge alerts, tracks a daily care streak, and shows charge history. Every battery figure is a clearly-labeled on-device estimate. Voltsy never claims to read Apple's official battery health or cycle count.

## App
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/voltsy-battery-care-buddy/id6778094814): Free, iOS, Utilities.
- [Pricing](https://voltsy.vercel.app/pricing.md): Free to download; Voltsy Pro is a one-time purchase, 4.99 US dollars in the United States (no subscription).
- [FAQ](https://voltsy.vercel.app/#faq): Battery-health honesty, the 20% to 80% zone, privacy, and pricing.

## Features
- Volt, a battery mascot that reacts live to your charge, so he is happy in the healthy zone, sleepy when low, dramatic at 1%, munching while charging.
- Charge alerts to unplug around 80% and a heads-up when you are running low.
- Daily care streak with a free Power Nap freeze, plus achievements for good charging habits.
- Charge history, a Home Screen widget, and a Lock Screen / Dynamic Island Live Activity.
- Honest by design: clearly-labeled on-device estimates only. iOS does not expose Apple's real battery-health percentage or cycle count to third-party apps.
